trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

- **Confirmed failure**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 in all production regions — the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc were both unhealthy, including v2.3.1-rc in staging). Rollback confirmed as rolled out.
- **Opened incident**: INC-0001 (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failure, the rollback action, and recommendations for on-call to verify recovery and investigate the v2.3.1 regression. The on-call engineer has been paged.
